fields.postcondition: the mapping builder validates property types at build time, rejecting unsupported property types with InvalidMapTypeException (or InvalidBinaryMappingLengthException for invalid fixed-width binary primitive lengths), while accepted types work across input parameters, output parameters, data-reader reads, and table-valued-parameter rows
fields.response: return true only for the CLR shapes declared for that attribute variant: the string-family variants (NVarChar, NChar, VarChar, Char) accept string, any enum type, or Nullable<enum>; MapToSqlBigIntAttribute accepts long, ulong, Nullable<long>, Nullable<ulong> (using unchecked same-width 64-bit conversion for ulong), or any non-nullable enum type (rejecting Nullable<enum>); MapToSqlIntAttribute, MapToSqlSmallIntAttribute, and MapToSqlTinyIntAttribute each accept their signed and unsigned same-width integer primitives (int/uint, short/ushort, and byte/sbyte respectively, using unchecked same-width conversion), Nullable<T> of those primitives, any enum type, or Nullable<enum>; the single-primitive scalar variants accept only their declared CLR type or Nullable<T> (Bit: bool; Decimal, Money, SmallMoney: decimal; Float: double; Real: float; DateTime, DateTime2: DateTime; Date: DateOnly; DateTimeOffset: DateTimeOffset; UniqueIdentifier: Guid); MapToSqlTimeAttribute accepts TimeSpan, TimeOnly, Nullable<TimeSpan>, or Nullable<TimeOnly>; MapToSqlBinaryAttribute and MapToSqlVarBinaryAttribute accept byte[], and additionally accept ulong, uint, ushort, sbyte, and their Nullable<T> forms using fixed-width big-endian 8/4/2/1-byte encoding (throwing InvalidBinaryMappingLengthException during IsValidType when the configured Length does not match the primitive width for Binary or is less than the primitive width for VarBinary, and throwing InvalidBinaryValueLengthException when a runtime byte payload length does not match the primitive width); MapToSqlJsonAttribute accepts System.Text.Json.JsonDocument; and MapToSqlTableValuedParameterAttribute accepts IEnumerable<T> collection properties for structured TVP binding (note that ShardKey serialization excludes ulong, uint, ushort, and sbyte)
fields.subject: SQL Server Type Mapping
fields.trigger: IsValidType evaluates a candidate CLR property type on a MapToSql* attribute
